title: Valued Mosaics
summary: Nakamura--Reyes showed that the category of commutative mosaics---unital reversible hypermagmas, without associativity---is complete, cocomplete, and has free objects, in contrast to commutative polygroups. Krasner's multivalued addition is designed around ultrametric balls; we take that valuation-theoretic motivation as primary and equip mosaics with valuations, as unit-reflecting unitary morphisms into the tropical polygroup $T(Γ)$.
